excludedWhy: Their interfaces are outside the approved N2b native binding. Arbitrary Owned callbacks cannot prove production termination.

families.account-close: Retries actual cleanup and waits for admission tokens. No caller cancellation exit. Persistent cleanup failure may require external repair; accepted limit4915 and diagnosis issue821.
families.admission-idle: Continuation ends when the actual admission Token closes. No cancellation shortcut. Permanent pending cleanup keeps it pending.
families.admission-phase: Phase delegates to executor. Release observation has a cancellation handler and optional timer; it never releases the actual hold.
families.blocking-executor: Cancellation handler marks a token, not the continuation. Worker Thread resumes continuation after the real body and afterReturn. A running synchronous OS command/body is not preempted.
families.bound-engine: Phase wrappers, bounded Authority RPCs, actor close and250ms cancellation-aware polling; Owned hooks are excluded from native proof. Registration can call mutating bounded launchctl bootstrap.
families.bound-native-entry: Creates real retained restoration Task; explicit initial check and phase checks cooperate only after that real Task is cancelled. Final cleanup still joins.
families.claim-and-result: Join/result waits do not cancel the producer or return early. Phase admission cooperates. Adopt consumes the real completed result and starts no replacement restore.
families.client-RPC: withTaskCancellationHandler closes transport and schedules actor finish to resume pending continuation. Timer also finishes. Pre/post checks observe cancellation; errors may map to needsOwnerRecovery.
families.client-healthy: Delegates to phase wrappers and bounded RPC invoke. Polling sleeps cooperate; Owned callback hooks are fixture controls only. Native code uses fixed context.
families.client-reconnect: Delegates to phase wrappers and bounded RPC invoke. Actual server effect can outlive transport cancellation; readback and durable state determine result.
families.client-unbound: RPC uses cancellation handler, transport close and five-second timer. Pre/post phases and actor scheduling remain distinct. Native driver uses NSXPC; callback data cannot grant authority.
families.completion-cleanup: Async engine result followed by uncancelled cleanup phase; derives completion only from the actual restored durable row.
families.direct-shutdown: Current close rejects recoveryBound, then waits owner.closeWhenIdle. Proposed shared finalizer must join registered endpoint work before successful account closure.
families.effect-dispatch: Dispatches fixed native engines or Owned-only adapters. Phase admission and real-result joins determine cancellation; no generic async signature proves cooperation.
families.endpoint: Delegates to original join, phase executor, real restoration result, or snapshot Task.value. close does not currently cancel/join the wrapper. See plan matrix.
families.final-close: Five-second observer may return timedOut on cancellation/time. Retained actual close task is never cancelled by that observer. No timedOut result proves lease release.
families.native-owner: Existing cancel marks token plus actual.cancel. run/join await actual task value/result. Cleanup completes before scope.close and joined notification.
families.native-owner-acquisition: Owner-minted phase acquisition delegates to blocking executor and current Host custody. Owned callbacks cannot establish native behavior.
families.original-invocation: Delegates to ledger real worker joins. Deinit reports cleanup only after synchronous rights closure returned.
families.original-join: Original deinit callback, cancelled registered worker real completion, then synchronous cleanup on executor. No early completion from waiter cancellation. Production registration call search found no external retainWorker/retainCleanup consumers.
families.real-task-and-publication: Task.result and original Task.value await real work. Publication continuation ends at start.open. No current requestCancellation API; shutdown-only bridge and race latch are proposed, not implemented.
families.restoration-phases: run/acquire check Task cancellation before phase admission; executor marks a separate token. Busy waits sleep25ms. cleanup creates a distinct uncancelled task with no deadline; afterRelease only cancels its observer.
families.retirement: Retirement Task awaits supervisor/discovery/idle/retries then actual closed result. waitUntilStopped is a noncancellable continuation. Independent300s watchdog exits75 as crash, not successful cleanup.
families.scheduling: Native sleeps/AsyncStreams cooperate or have scheduling deadline. Task.value joins remain real. Admission closure wakes slot waiters; timing callbacks are bounded only in native mode or controlled fixtures.
families.supervisor-join: Cancels real NativeOwner through handler; joins entry tasks and owner cleanup tasks without caller-cancellation shortcut. Current snapshot excludes endpoint tasks; N2b adds the shared session join capability.
families.unbound-engine: Forward phases/RPCs cooperate with real-task cancellation; cleanup and actual custody close ignore caller cancellation. Transport cancellation is not proof of remote effect cancellation.

scope: N2b restore/adopt engines, claims, original joins, shared supervisor/final-close paths, and cancellation helpers. Other Setup operations and separate restart-only entry points are excluded.
